entity.summary: Iranian centralized cryptocurrency exchange and investment platform launched in 2018, offering account-based crypto trading, rial and crypto deposits and withdrawals, custody and related financial services. The platform remained publicly operational in August 2026.
entity.notes: The current first-party site states that Aban Tether began in 1397 (2018) and exposes registration, identity verification, rial and crypto funding, trading and withdrawals for more than 1,000 cryptoassets. HEI uses 2018-01-01 as a year-level launch marker because the reviewed first-party source establishes the year but not an exact day.

evidence.title: Aban Tether cryptocurrency exchange and investment platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform states that Aban Tether began in 1397 (2018), reports more than four million users and more than 1,000 tradable cryptoassets, and exposes account registration, KYC, rial and crypto deposits, trading, custody and withdrawals. Used to establish entity identity, launch year and current operational status.
